paragraphs.text: Varnel Buckara was the Master of the Orange House of Fentesk , in the city of Estark on Dominaria . He participated in the Night of Fire , the destruction of the House of Oor-tael .
He was a very lascivious man, who loved being surrounded by beautiful and young women: in his harem he had "far more" than fifty of them. He slit the throat of his first consort in 4067 AR .
After Garth joined his house, Varnel took a 3000 gold bribe from Zarel to bar Fentesk's door allowing the Grand Master to capture him.

He was killed by the Grand Master of Arena Zarel , when the latter decided to destroy the four Houses. Zarel cast a spell on Varnel, which caused him to age rapidly until all that was left of him were his skeletal remains.
